title: Best OP Auto Tackle Auto Shoot Auto Goalkeeper Items
features:
Ronix Hub - Illegal Soccer

Combat
- Auto Tackle and Auto Block, each with its own range slider
- Tackle Cooldown slider from 0.1 to 3 seconds, plus Manual Tackle and Manual Pass
- Auto Shoot with Shoot Power and Shoot Angle sliders, and a Manual Shoot button
- Auto Power Kick with its own power slider, and Auto Rainbow Flick with a delay
- Auto Goalkeeper on Auto Clear, Auto Dive or Auto Save, with a reaction time slider
- Auto Steal Ball up to 40 studs away, plus Manual Clear and Manual Dive buttons

Ball Control
- Auto Dribble, Auto Pass and Auto Call For Pass with a receive range

Items
- Auto Use Selected Item on a cooldown, or pick from 14 per-item toggles
- Freeze Gun, Bazooka, Jetpack, Magnet, Grappling Hook and more, each on its own switch

Movement
- Walk Speed up to 200 and Jump Power up to 200, with a reset button
- Auto Sprint, Auto Dodge with a cooldown, Auto Slide and Auto Jump, plus manual buttons

Teleport
- Go to the ball, either goal, the center, or any player by name
- Nearest enemy or teammate teleport, Server Hop and Auto Server Hop by player count

Shop
- Auto Buy Items with a max price, Auto Claim Daily Reward and code redeem

Ranked and Clubs
- Auto Join Ranked by queue type and Auto Join Club Match

Settings
- FPS Boost, Potato Mode, No Shadows and an FPS Cap, plus saved configs

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
